user.title: Gamified GTD
user.description: Select the persons to create a profile for, and set the global options.

special.title: S.P.E.C.I.A.L.
special.description: Like character creation in Fallout: New Vegas: every attribute starts at 5 and you freely distribute 5 more points — you may raise or lower values (1-10 each); the total must be exactly 40.

goat.title: G.O.A.T.
goat.description:
Answer all 10 questions of the Generalized Occupational Aptitude Test (Vault 101) — your 3 Tag! skills are determined automatically.

{questions}

tags.title: Tag! skills
tags.description: Choose 3 Tag! skills (+15 each) manually. While character creation is pending, the G.O.A.T. runs directly after S.P.E.C.I.A.L. instead; the 'Gamified GTD — G.O.A.T.' card (custom:gamified-gtd-goat) remains as an optional alternative.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Notify service per person (empty = none), daily summary and HA notification center.

data.summary_enabled: Send daily summary of open tasks
data.ha_notification: Also post to the HA notification center
data.unassigned_to_all: Send unassigned tasks to every configured person
